title: Faster Base64 Encoding and Decoding Using AVX2 Instructions
key_contribution: Introduced PSHUFB-based nibble lookup for Base64 achieving 10x encoding and 7x decoding speedup over scalar implementations using AVX2.

title: Base64 decoding with SIMD instructions
key_contribution: Detailed comparison of 5 vector lookup strategies (base, byte-blend, incremental, pshufb, pshufb-bitmask) with the bitmask variant achieving 0.75 instructions/character.

title: Implementing byte-wise lookup table with PSHUFB
key_contribution: Generalized the PSHUFB lookup technique beyond Base64 to arbitrary byte-to-byte mappings using nibble decomposition and bitmask validation.

title: Base64 encoding & decoding using AVX512BW instructions
key_contribution: Extended PSHUFB lookup to AVX-512BW (32-byte lanes) and AVX-512VBMI (VPERMB full-width byte permutation) for further throughput gains.
